title: Package policy pack, semantic tool manifest, and ModelBroker defaults
purpose: Create packageable default configs for Alpha policy, semantic tools, and ModelBroker without weakening runtime safety.
scope: Define /etc/agentos/policy defaults with approval binding, denied shell, and high-risk pause rules.
Define /etc/agentos/tools/semantic-tools.json with allowed semantic tools and no normal-mode shell.exec.
Define /etc/agentos/model-broker.toml with stub/local-only default mode and optional remote providers disabled.
Define config validation and no-secret checks.
acceptance_criteria: Policy defaults preserve exact approval token binding.
Semantic tool manifest excludes shell.exec in normal mode.
ModelBroker default works without network or external credentials.
Config files do not contain raw secrets.
verification: Run semantic tool route tests or manifest validation.
Run policy gate tests or config validation.
Confirm ModelBroker stub/local-only mode is the default.
risk_notes: Packaging defaults can accidentally become the authority layer; they must reflect existing runtime code, not bypass it.
implementation_steps: Define packageable config contents from existing docs and runtime behavior.
Add validation checks for denied shell, high-risk pause, and stub/local-only model mode.
Add evidence linking config defaults to runtime tests.
Ensure config contains handles and metadata only, not secrets.
failure_modes: Config diverges from runtime code behavior.

verification_matrix.command: cargo test -p agentd safety:: && cargo test -p agentd agent_core::adversarial
verification_matrix.expected: Safety and abuse gates still pass after config packaging

blocked_until: Policy, tools, and ModelBroker package defaults are defined.
